ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In order to carry out bioremediation of soil polluted by heavy metals, researchers connected the heavy metal transporter protein (HMA3) gene cloned from poplar with an exogenous highly efficient promoter and introduced it into the poplar genome (as shown in the figure). To detect whether the obtained transgenic poplar seedlings contain the introduced HMA3 gene, while avoiding interference from the endogenous HMA3 gene, which two-primer combination should be selected when performing PCR amplification?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In order to carry out bioremediation of soil polluted by heavy metals, researchers connected the heavy metal transporter protein (HMA3) gene cloned from poplar with an exogenous highly efficient promoter and introduced it into the poplar genome (as shown in the figure). To detect whether the obtained transgenic poplar seedlings contain the introduced HMA3 gene, while avoiding interference from the endogenous HMA3 gene, which two-primer combination should be selected when performing PCR amplification?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the inserted fragment is located between poplar endogenous DNA, and from left to right the left border, promoter, HMA3 gene, terminator, and right border are marked in sequence. Primer ① is located above the exogenous promoter region, directed to the right; primer ② is located below the HMA3 gene region, directed to the left; primer ③ is located above near the HMA3 gene, directed to the right; primer ④ is located below the HMA3 gene region, directed to the left. Then reason: The question asks to detect whether the transgenic poplar seedlings contain the introduced HMA3 gene, while avoiding interference from the poplar's own endogenous HMA3 gene. If both primers are designed inside the HMA3 gene, then the endogenous HMA3 gene may also be amplified, and the introduced gene cannot be distinguished from the endogenous gene. One primer located on the exogenous highly efficient promoter and one reverse primer located inside the HMA3 gene should be selected, so that the amplified fragment crosses the "exogenous promoter—HMA3 gene" junction region; this junction exists only in the introduced transgenic structure. Therefore, ① and ② should be selected.
